service.name: Series Malmstones Boost (PvP)
service.longDescription: The Series Malmstones system provides unique rewards to players who participate in PvP during a given series. Leveling up lets you acquire Trophy Crystals, Minions, Mounts and Sets of Glamour!

rewards.title: PvP Series Levels
rewards.text: Multiple levels in the PvP series granting you the current series loot.

rewards.title: Trophy Crystals
rewards.text: Thousands of Trophy Crystals to exchange for glamour.

rewards.title: PvP Experience
rewards.text: Exclusive exp only acquired from playing in PvP game modes.

rewards.title: Mount OR Gearset
rewards.text: Unique Mount or Gearset depending on the current PvP series at level 25.
